positive: An interface needs coherent light, dark, high-contrast, or forced-colors mappings
Theme switching or persistent preference needs implementation
negative: The request is to invent the source palette rather than map semantic roles
The request is a one-off color correction with no theme-system scope

exclusions: Do not invert a light palette and call it dark mode
Do not override user forced-colors behavior

required: Supported theme modes and target surfaces

outputs.primary: Semantic mappings for every supported theme, plus forced-colors behavior, preference policy, and measured pairs

stop_conditions: Pause when semantic roles are missing and theme values would be raw-color copies
Do not claim a theme is accessible without per-theme measurements
